capabilities: Analyse word frequencies across all notes in the vault
Display similar notes with similarity scores in a right-hand sidebar view
Open a similar note in the editor by clicking it
Reopen the sidebar via an 'Open Lookalike sidebar' command
extras: README lists an unimplemented feature roadmap (similarity threshold, result limits, exclusions, alternative algorithms); note the plugin folder id is spelled 'note-promixity'.
problem: Obsidian's search finds notes by matching query terms but doesn't automatically suggest notes similar to the one you're currently viewing.
summary: Similarity finder that surfaces notes related to the current note by comparing term frequencies across the vault.
